title: Anna's Cake
text:
Anna wants to make a cake. She needs eggs, flour and milk. First, she mixes the eggs and the milk in a big bowl. Then she adds the flour.

Next, Anna puts the cake in the oven. It bakes for thirty minutes. Anna is happy when the cake is ready. She eats a big piece with her mother.

questions.text: What does Anna need to make a cake?
How long does the cake bake in the oven?
Why does Anna feel happy at the end?
options: Because the cake is ready and she can eat it
Because she does not like cake

questions.text: What can you say about Anna?
options: She likes to cook and share food
She does not like her mother
She is afraid of the oven

vocabulary.definition: a sweet food made with flour, eggs and sugar and baked in an oven
a round, deep dish used for mixing or serving food
a closed box used for heating and baking food
a white powder made from grain and used to bake bread and cakes

paragraph_translations: Анна хоче випекти торт. Їй потрібні яйця, борошно і молоко. Спочатку вона змішує яйця і молоко у великій мисці. Потім вона додає борошно.
Далі Анна ставить торт у духовку. Він випікається тридцять хвилин. Анна щаслива, коли торт готовий. Вона їсть великий шматок разом з мамою.
